stem: A suspect propagation tray must be inspected more closely. Which action best protects biosecurity?
choices: Move the tray into a clean room temporarily.
Use the same uncleaned tools on suspect and clean trays.
Inspect using the approved quarantine/sanitation workflow or escalate if the needed inspection cannot preserve the boundary.
Release the tray because the cause is not confirmed.
rationale: Inspect using the approved quarantine/sanitation workflow or escalate if the needed inspection cannot preserve the boundary.
